paragraphs: SRH International College is a Navitas Advantage pathway college that prepares international students for degrees at SRH University — one of Germany's largest private university groups. The College operates campuses in Heidelberg (Ludwig-Guttmann-Str. 6), Berlin (Sonnenallee 221 in Neukölln), and a third Munich campus launching in October 2026.

All instruction is delivered entirely in English in small classes, with a student body representing 100+ nationalities. Students gain access to state-of-the-art labs and creative studios on the SRH campuses, plus 20 hours/week of work permission while studying and 18 months post-graduation work rights under German law.

The College offers three pathway tracks — Intensive English Foundation (3 semesters, entry from IELTS 4.0), Foundation programmes in Business, Creative Studies, or Engineering & IT (2 semesters), and one-semester Pre-Master's programmes in Business, Computing, or Engineering and IT Management. Progression to SRH University degrees is automatic on passing all required modules.

Pre-Master's tracks lead into SRH Master's programmes including Cyber Security, Big Data & AI, Applied Data Science & Analytics, International Business & Engineering, and Digital Transformation Management.
paragraphsRu: SRH International College — pathway-колледж Navitas Advantage, готовящий международных студентов к программам SRH University, одной из крупнейших частных университетских групп Германии. Колледж работает на кампусах в Heidelberg (Ludwig-Guttmann-Str. 6), Berlin (Sonnenallee 221 в Neukölln) и третьем кампусе Munich, запускающемся в октябре 2026.

Всё преподавание — на английском в маленьких группах, студенческое сообщество — 100+ национальностей. Доступ к state-of-the-art lab и creative studios на кампусах SRH, плюс 20 часов работы в неделю во время учёбы и 18 месяцев post-graduation work под немецким законом.

Колледж предлагает три pathway-трека — Intensive English Foundation (3 семестра, вход с IELTS 4.0), Foundation в Business, Creative Studies или Engineering & IT (2 семестра), и одно-семестровые Pre-Master's в Business, Computing или Engineering and IT Management. Прогрессия в SRH University автоматическая при сдаче всех модулей.
Pre-Master's треки ведут в Master's SRH — Cyber Security, Big Data & AI, Applied Data Science & Analytics, International Business & Engineering и Digital Transformation Management.
